video_title: Training Camp Media Availability | September 29, 2026 | OKC Thunder

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.text: I've always just whether I know what I'm doing or not, I've always tried to lead by example, do the right thing, lead with effort and hard work. But I definitely feel a little bit of responsibility to communicate as somebody who's been here a couple years, played for a couple years. I feel like I have an understanding that some people might not, and just try to help them out along the way. I also don't think I'm immune to somebody pointing something out to me, and I think it's the best way to build a chemistry and a flow together is for everybody to be communicating with each other.
quotes.news_angle: Unidentified speaker embraces his role as a veteran leader for the Thunder.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says he feels a responsibility to lead and communicate with his teammates as he enters his third season with the Thunder.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.text: He's driving across LA to come play with us up at the new PA gym, driving across LA to use the track at UCLA. He's a grinder. I mean, we saw it last year, but where you really get to see it and notice it from guys is when you get into the off-season and he's very intentional about his work and it was great to be in the gym with him and get that work in.
quotes.news_angle: Unidentified speaker praises Jalen Williams for his work ethic during the offseason.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says Jalen Williams is a grinder who has been very intentional about his work this offseason.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.text: The fall was good. The guys did a really good job in the fall. The young guys have been here a long time. They've put a lot of work in, but we're very careful not to make it feel like practice because we want practice to feel like practice. We want the first day to have an energy to it and it did. Guys came in in pretty good shape, great focus and attention.
quotes.news_angle: Unidentified speaker says the Thunder players arrived at training camp in great shape.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says the Thunder players arrived at training camp in great shape and with great focus.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.text: It's a dynamic game and the game's only getting faster with the pace of play, not only up and down the floor but in the half court. And so your ability to pace with that on offense and pace with it on defense is critical and the faster you're moving, the faster you have to think. And so it's absolutely a huge part of the game at this point, always has been, but certainly more so because the pace is increased.
quotes.news_angle: Unidentified speaker emphasizes the importance of processing speed in the modern NBA.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says the game is getting faster and players must be able to think as quickly as they move.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.text: He's one of those guys, I give him a lot of credit because he's really evolved as a leader. He's always had an outsized amount of influence in the locker room, even when we were a younger team and he was a younger player. He's always kind of had a lot of stroke in the locker room. The guys really respect him and he's learned over time, he's become more vocal, he's chosen his spots more, he's learned how to leverage that influence that he's built up.
quotes.news_angle: Unidentified speaker credits Shai Gilgeous-Alexander for his growth as a leader.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has evolved into a vocal leader who knows how to leverage his influence in the locker room.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.text: Sam mentioned in his media that those guys are limited in camp. That's true. It is good to have them out here participating in what they're participating in, but they are limited.
quotes.news_angle: Unidentified speaker confirms several players are limited at the start of training camp.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker confirms that some players are limited at the start of training camp due to injury.
